# DELTA fixture provenance. Generated by test/data/parquet/gen-delta.py;
# sha256 and size as committed.
# unsupported-bss.parquet is refusal-only: the read refuses its
# BYTE_STREAM_SPLIT page before any decode, so expected.txt records no oracle.
# Encoding convention: `physical` and `converted` describe column 0 of a
# multi-column file; `encodings` is the file-wide union across all columns,
# with the RLE definition-level encoding listed explicitly (the writer
# records the value encodings it chose; the level encoding comes from the
# page layout).
# Footer metadata: gen-delta.py rewrites the writer's own created_by
# stamp and renames the writer's optional schema entry to `schema:bytes`,
# both in place at the same byte length, so offsets and sizes are
# unchanged. The rename is deliberate: the reader ignores footer
# key-value metadata, and regeneration with a writer that adds more
# footer keys fails loudly in gen-delta.py.
# fixture rows row_groups physical converted encodings page_kind writer sha256 size
